source_review: Only the existing combined current-version test, existing plan and ledger differ from baseline; no application/schema/workflow/README change.
Actual raw PostgreSQL population precedes the authored first failure; all 43 table states return to the initially empty private staging state, with no final destination.
Second authored failure follows a real journal-file rename after raw metadata/sequence commit; the copied inventory is a strict subset of the original with every copied entry equal.
Third authored failure follows the real final directory rename; exact marker/raw tables/sequences/tree/modes and a normal retry reconcile the completed destination.
Source and backup/catalog byte and POSIX-mode checks now run at every interruption and final post-cold-read boundary; preliminary strengthening is resolved.

Current app activation keeps immutable completed recovery acknowledgement, original interrupted Run/events, recovered publication Ref and measured/incomplete timing records; actual SDK and separate CLI collect the same exact bytes without compute replay.
The authored generation_jobs high-water fixture is explicit; its retained value20/is_calledtrue survives committed state, retry and cold consumer reads.
No backward-compatibility/automatic-migration witness, synthetic PUB1/SCI1 acceptance, preparation-cache claim or performance result is introduced.
remaining_gates: Current published-head required hosted checks and final report/source binding before authorized merge.
limits: Controlled Python exceptions/retry are qualified, not host crash, kill, power loss or storage-device durability.
Partial-copy proof covers a strict subset of complete verified files, not torn file payloads.
POSIX mode bits are compared; ownership/ACL/xattr/timestamp preservation is not newly qualified.
Job-order tables are empty; the high-water mark is explicit administrative fixture state, not arbitrary populated-sequence rollback proof.
Real neutral execution and PostgreSQL recovery/consumer integrity are covered, not scientific training acceptance or a performance comparison.
Full M2/M3/M5/T8 acceptance is not implied; real PUB1/SCI1 inputs remain missing.
